description.en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
The name of the node group.

description.zh:
混合云节点组类型。取值：

- **protect**：防护。

- **control**：管控。

- **storage**：存储。

- **controlStorage**：管控＆存储。
description.en:
The type of the hybrid cloud node group. Valid values:

- **protect**: protection.

- **control**: control.

- **storage**: storage.

- **controlStorage**: control and storage.
The hostname of the server that you want to query.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The IP address of the server that you want to query.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-cluster-servers --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000000nd07 --cluster-id 1 --ip 1.X.X.1 --host-name online-000wwq --group-type protect --group-name test --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
